messages:
incident-bot: Pager: P0 - routing-policy spike + dedicated pool misbind detected for customer tenant 'acme-corp' - alerts from 1725556610. Severity: high. @sara is on-call.

sara (oncall): seeing 502s and high latency for a handful of requests. Dashboard shows sudden inbound to dedicated-pool-east instead of hosted pool. Impacting 3 customer sessions (ACME prod). I'm paging infra.

raj (infra): on it. initial hypothesis: recent policy rollout v2.3.1 changed tier-match order. Reproducing in staging now.

maria (sre): user-visible symptom summary from telemetry: 15% error rate spike, tail latency 95% > 2s, token throughput drop. Affected region: us-east-1. Affected model variants: rdl-1.3-q8 -> should have matched rdl-1.3-hosted.

kevin (customer-success): pinging ACME CS lead now, they report timeouts in their chat flows. Customer-facing note drafted: "We are investigating routing impact; temporary workaround in progress."

tom (eng-runtime): logs show schema mismatch during fallback selection: policy engine returned fallback variant id 'rdl-1.3-dedicated' for hosted-only tenant. Looks like tenant isolation predicate mis-evaluated. Snippet: `policy_decision: { tenant: "acme-corp", preferred_tier: "hosted", selected_pool: "dedicated-pool-east", rule_id: "tier-blend-v2" }`

raj (infra): rolling rollback of tier-blend-v2 to previous stable. Preparing config rollback. Will push to canary then global.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: config-rollout tier-blend-v2 -> tier-blend-v1. Canary to 2 nodes in us-east-1. ID: deploy-8243.

maria (sre): quick mitigation: enable strict-tenant-isolation flag for routing-engine for acme-corp via runtime override. Doing now.

tom (eng-runtime): patch ready: `--routing.strictTenantIsolation=true` for tenant acme-corp. Applying via admin API.

raj (infra): canary rollback complete on 2 nodes. Observability - request streams dropping into dedicated pool reduced by ~80%.

maria (sre): error rate dropping. 502s trending to baseline. Can we hold the strictTenantIsolation flag while we fully rollback?

tom (eng-runtime): yes, leaving override in place until config is stable across regions. I'll also add a guard to prevent fallback to dedicated for hosted-flagged tenants. Small PR queued: runtime#5876.

kevin (customer-success): ACME confirmed partial recovery, their retries normalized. They're asking if any data exposure occurred.

maria (sre): no evidence of data plane cross-tenant access. Only routing misassignment that directed requests to wrong pool; logs show no cross-tenant KV reads. Will include this in post-incident report.

raj (infra): global rollback of the policy completed at 1725556712. Observability: 95th latency and error rate back to normal.

incident-bot: Incident timeline: triggered 1725556610, canary rollback 1725556698, global rollback 1725556712, mitigation override applied 1725556702.

kevin (customer-success): I've sent a brief to ACME support with ETA for RCA. They want a follow-up within 2 hours.

maria (sre): next steps: postmortem, add integration test for tier-match ordering, add canary gating enforcement for policy rollouts, verify tenant isolation flag is covered by unit tests. Assign owners: tom -> runtime guard, raj -> rollout gating, maria -> postmortem draft.

tom (eng-runtime): noted. I'll land the runtime guard PR and fast-track tests.

raj (infra): I'll add rollout validation that checks tenant predicates against a static sample set before promoting policy.

maria (sre): incident declared RESOLVED (mitigated) at 1725556729. Will open a follow-up thread for the full postmortem. Thanks all for quick turnaround. :white_check_mark:
